subject: Request: Additional trial runway after integration hold — BrightScale
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@brightscale.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration stall — asking for trial runway extension and sandbox top-up

Hi Mateo,

Appreciate you taking the time earlier. Quick recap — our engineering work to hook BrightScale into Redwood's embeddings pipeline has hit a blocker after a third‑party connector upgrade. Our eng lead (cc'd) reproduced an intermittent tokenization mismatch that is preventing the final validation step.

Because of this, our PO's window for the POC has effectively shrunk. Can we request a 30‑day extension on the trial and an additional sandbox/top‑up of tokens so our QA team can finish regression tests once the connector fix is in? We're hoping to avoid restarting the onboarding clock.

Attached: error_trace.log and a screenshot of the failed validation in staging.

What information do you need from us to get this approved quickly?

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Integrations
BrightScale

Attachments: error_trace.log (text), screenshot_integration.png (png)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightscale.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration stall — asking for trial runway extension and sandbox top-up

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the logs.

I reviewed the error_trace.log quickly and have looped in Soojin from our integration team to look deeper. Two quick asks so we can move this through approvals rapidly:
- Can your team confirm a minimal repro (steps + small dataset) that our engineers can run locally?
- Do you need credits for load/regression or just a token cushion for validation runs?

Operational note: trial extensions and token top‑ups are granted as one‑time exceptions by our Sales Ops team; I can escalate but will need a short justification and an estimate of token consumption. Based on the initial look, I think a temporary 30‑day runway + 500k token sandbox top‑up is reasonable if Soojin confirms the fix window.

If you can send the repro + estimated token usage today, I will prepare the approval package and tag Marissa (manager) for sign‑off.

—Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightscale.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration stall — asking for trial runway extension and sandbox top-up

Hi Samira — I dug into the stack trace you attached. A few observations:
1) The tokenization mismatch looks tied to an upstream connector change that altered how punctuation is normalized before token encoding. That explains the intermittent failures during regression tests.
2) Quick workaround: force our tokenizer to fall back to legacy normalization for the connector host. I can push a config change to staging in ~48–72 hours if you can provide a small sanitized sample and the exact API call sequence that triggers the mismatch.

If we can get a repro sample, I will:
- apply the staging config change and run your failing test suite
- collect logs and sanity results and share a runbook

Once validated, we can coordinate a short maintenance window to deploy the permanent fix.

Sooj
Staff SWE, Integrations | Redwood Inference

P.S. Mateo — from a technical POV, 48–72 hours to a staging verification sounds realistic. Will circle back with exact token burn after test runs.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightscale.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration stall — asking for trial runway extension and sandbox top-up

Hi Samira — thanks for the note and for working with our eng team. I reviewed the context and am approving a one‑time accommodation to keep your POC on track. Details below:

Approved:
- Trial runway extension: +30 days (effective from today)
- Sandbox top‑up: 500,000 token credit added to your trial account

Conditions and next steps:
1) Please upload the minimal repro/sample as requested by Soojin and reply-all so we have the same thread for verification.
2) I'll create an approval artifact and a short amendment to the trial SOW. You'll receive a DocuSign link to acknowledge the one‑time extension (no additional charges).
3) Mateo will update your HubSpot record (deal BS-2028-0421) with the extension details.

Attachment: trial_extension_approval.pdf (approval stub).
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/brightscale
DocuSign: https://na0.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSign?env=na0&=trial-extension-0412

Samira — happy to fast‑track anything else you need to keep momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
.Attachments: trial_extension_approval.pdf
